subtitle: Unified Earth & Climate Data Platform
data_note: Search NASA catalogues and retrieve selected data. This app does not mirror the entire archive.
hero_desc: Discover, retrieve and analyse NASA climate and satellite data in one workspace.
overview_desc: Choose coordinates or click on the map.
location_sub: Click the map to set coordinates.
quick_power_sub: A sample of daily NASA POWER data
chart_sub: Values returned by NASA POWER; each parameter has its own unit axis.
power_explain: POWER provides solar and meteorological parameters. Coverage, temporal resolution and units depend on the selected parameter.
param_dictionary: Parameter dictionary supported in this release
catalog_desc: Discover SMAP, MODIS and other mission collections in CMR.
catalog_notice: A Collection describes a data product; a Granule is a specific data unit/file. Select granules to download; Earthdata login may be required.
faq_desc: Practical answers about sources, products, quality and data interpretation.
ws_desc: Save, reproduce and export scientific analyses with full metadata.
map_hint: 🖱 Click the map or enter coordinates
guide_start_desc: Pick a location, define the analysis type, then review the data source and time range.
geo_ph: 🔍 Search any city, village or farm worldwide...
data_guide_summary: 📖 Data guide — what does each parameter mean? (for better understanding)
dg_t2m_d: Mean air temperature in °C — for planting, irrigation and cold-management decisions.
dg_rain_d: Total rainfall in mm — the key factor for rain-fed farming and irrigation planning.
dg_rh_d: Relative humidity in % — for plant-disease outlook and evaporation.
dg_solar_d: Solar energy reaching the surface in kWh/m² — for solar panels and crop growth.
dg_wind_d: Wind speed at 10 m in m/s — for spraying, harvest and evaporation.
dg_evap_d: Water evaporated from the surface in mm — reflects the real water need of plants.
dg_levels: Daily = each day · Hourly = each hour · Monthly = average per month · Climatology = long-term multi-year average
dg_communities: AG = Agroclimatology · RE = Renewable energy · SB = Sustainable buildings · HY = Hydrology and water
dg_read: In the analysis cards each parameter shows mean, min, max and trend with its unit; the CSV file contains all raw values.
gibs_desc: Real remote-sensing imagery — NDVI, EVI, land surface temperature, SMAP soil moisture. Data are published with a multi-day delay.
split_hint: Left: first date · Right: second date — GIBS is for visual context, not quantitative data
chart_empty_sub: Select parameters and press "Fetch NASA data"
climate_desc: Scientific drought and climate indicators from real NASA POWER data — SPI, SPEI, anomalies, heatwaves.
clim_m1: SPI/SPEI: standard meteorological drought indices based on precipitation and PET from NASA POWER — gridded model data, not direct on-farm measurement.
clim_m2: GDD: growing degree days = accumulation of (Tmax+Tmin)/2 minus the crop base temperature.
clim_m3: Limitation: accuracy depends on the completeness of the POWER time series; SPI values at grid edges are less reliable.
agent_tab_desc: Ask your question in plain language — the intelligence engine selects and analyses real data and shows its sources.
agent_ph: e.g. What is the drought status of wheat in Shiraz?
agent_ex4: How large is global wheat production?
fao_center_desc: Official annual statistics for Iran; independent of NASA climate data.
fao_ready: Select a crop and press fetch to get statistics.
fao_world_desc: Country rankings from real FAOSTAT data — ranks are computed from the live response, no hard-coded country codes.
fao_note: This section only displays official data retrieved from FAOSTAT. If the API is unavailable, no substitute data is shown. FAOSTAT yield reported in hectograms per hectare is converted to tonnes per hectare.
cat_q_ph: e.g. SMAP soil moisture or MOD13Q1
advisor_desc: Automatic analysis of real weather data (NASA POWER) and agricultural statistics (FAOSTAT) with practical suggestions — in plain language.
adv_loc_hint: Click the map in the Overview tab or enter coordinates
adv_ready: Select a crop and press analyse.
advisor_how: This section fetches the last 30 days of weather data (temperature, rain, humidity, radiation, evaporation) from NASA POWER for your farm coordinates and reviews production and yield trends from official FAOSTAT statistics; then simple agricultural rules produce practical suggestions in plain language. Every suggestion shows its data source.

ps_hint: For a more precise agricultural interpretation, go to the Agri Advisor tab.

cli_formulas: Formulas and sources for each indicator
